AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
